pages.title: The Shape of a Journey
pages.text: Prepare a travelling companion whose native form depends on its surroundings.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Hire the creature using its own payment rules; chains retain a chosen form. Dimensions stay subject to the normal campaign gates, and visiting every dimension is not required.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: Use milk for Croissant Dragon, the required Mage gear for Golden Allay, or coins for hostile Imp. Native messages identify distinct taming prerequisites and prevent assuming a universal food.

pages.title: How it works
pages.text: A hostile Imp uses its own native hiring coin. Economy coins are separate items and purposes; follow the actual creature tooltip.
